description: Supports vélo - Ville de Séné is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata56.fr. Location of bike racks - City of Sene. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Bike racks - City of Séné" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include vélo, stationnement, séné, Aménagement du territoire, Urbanisme, Bâtiments. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2019-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
